answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to work in music public relations and artist marketing, helping artists build meaningful careers through strategic storytelling, branding, and fan engagement.
answers.drew: I’ve always been drawn to the way entertainment brings people together and creates lasting emotional connections. What excites me most is the storytelling behind an artist or project and the opportunity to help that story reach the right audience. Through my experience in public relations and social media, I’ve discovered that I enjoy the strategy just as much as the creativity, whether that’s building campaigns, developing an artist’s brand, or finding unique ways to connect with fans. Working in the music industry, in particular, has shown me how much impact thoughtful marketing and PR can have on an artist’s career.
answers.seeking: I’m looking to connect with people who are passionate about music and entertainment, especially those working in artist management, public relations, marketing, A&R, live events, brand partnerships, and the creative side of the industry. I also enjoy meeting fellow students and emerging professionals who are eager to collaborate, share ideas, and build meaningful relationships.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is Tree Paine. I’ve always admired how she has shaped one of the most successful careers in music through thoughtful public relations and strategic storytelling. She’s built a reputation for protecting her clients while creating impactful campaigns that strengthen their brands and connect with audiences. Seeing the influence a publicist can have behind the scenes has inspired me to pursue a career in music PR, where I hope to help artists tell their stories, navigate their careers, and build lasting relationships with fans.
